title: Autonomy loop on atomic relations
description: A goal in English becomes bound slots (measure, dimension, slice). The loop seeds chains of atoms, checks each against spec/analytics-composites.json, rolls legal chains out on the dummy sandbox, scores them against the goal, keeps the best, mutates them one atom at a time, and repeats until the budget or a stable best. The winner is a RelOp with a dummy ticket; it may then replay live. Never SQL from an SLM.

selfDirected.note: The engine forms and tests its own hypotheses first; the strongest supported one becomes the objective of this search.

mutations.text: Rebind a measure slot to another schema measure (prefer the goal measure).
Rebind a dimension slot to another schema dimension (prefer the goal dimension).
Insert one restrict atom using a schema sample value or a zero threshold.
Insert one cut atom after the collapse.
Insert one compare atom after the collapse.
Ensure the chain ends with an order and a cap.
Prefix of one parent up to its collapse plus the suffix of another parent from its collapse.

placement: A new atom is inserted where its phase rank fits (non-decreasing). check_chain still decides legality; illegal chains never reach the sandbox.

score.note: A search heuristic over RelOps that ran on the dummy. Not business truth, not causal truth.

may: propose bind names that resolve in the built schema

honesty: Winning chains are RelOps that ran on the dummy sandbox and, when allowed, replayed live. The score is a search heuristic. Identification is none.
